CustomObject.description: The Decision Criterion type holds one row of the Pillar B decision matrix: a Description, the client's Default Weight (0 to 10) and a Sort Order. Read by DecisionMatrixController. Commonly used for setting the weights the reset button restores.
CustomObject.label: Decision Criterion

validationRules.description: The matrix sliders run from 0 to 10, so the default weight must sit inside that range.
validationRules.errorMessage: Default Weight must be a number from 0 to 10.
